notes: Text is kept as printed, including the paper's own typos (Q477 "Amercian", Q497 "techinque", Q500 "Paraphillias"; the cover page title says "Pschology").

Page numbers are the image file numbers (pNN.png) of the page where the question header (Question Number / Question Id) is printed; the printed footer is one lower. The stem image sometimes sits at the top of the next page.
The PDF repeats every question in Hindi after the English; only the English text is kept.
Two comprehension passages: Q491-495 (Seema) and Q496-500 (Abby); the passage text is under passages and each sub-question names its passage.
The paper's group says 42 questions to attempt in the header text but prints 50 numbered questions (451-500); all 50 are authenticated.
Match items are written as 'LIST-I item | LIST-II item' rows.

Key caution for the checkers: n 16 (strong sexual urges into religious fervor) is keyed to 'Reaction formation' by NTA's final key; a textbook would say sublimation, which is not offered. The key is kept exactly as NTA published it; whether it can be 'covered' is for the strict rule to judge (never bend a verdict). n 22 (NOT a dimension of stress) is keyed to 'Controllability'; check NCERT before relying on it.
Authenticated = the question id is in the key and the key option id is one of the four printed option ids.
OCR slips fixed: none needed in the text (it was read from the images, not from the OCR); the OCR of the ids matched the key for 50 of 50 questions.

P1-226895781416.title: Seema and repetitive acts
P1-226895781416.text: Reeva noticed that Seema washes her hands very frequently. In addition to this, she used to walk only within the patterns drawn on the floor or road. Further, it was noticed that she was unable to control her preoccupation with specific ideas and failed to prevent herself from repeatedly carrying out a particular act or a series of acts. Therefore, Seema experiences anxiety and disturbances in her life. These pattern of thoughts and behaviour have affected her ability to carry out normal activities.

P2-226895781422.title: Abby and behavioural therapy
P2-226895781422.text: Abby is very annoying by nature. He does not follow what his parents say and refuses to obey them. He constantly bothers his parents and classmates with his improper behavior and does not regularly complete the homework given by his teachers. After seeing Abby's behavior, his parents take him to a psychotherapist in order to understand why he behaves the way he does. The psychotherapist planned to administer behavioural therapy for modifying his behaviour.
